name: Christopher M. Drury

about: Civil trial lawyer and the founder of Drury Law Firm in Coral Gables, Florida, Christopher M. Drury serves clients throughout Miami. He represents people in personal injury matters, business litigation, class action and mass torts, medical malpractice, product liability, admiralty and maritime law, and bad faith and insurance disputes.

Graduating cum laude from Davidson College in 2000, with a Bachelor of Arts in Classics, Mr. Drury went on to study law at the University of Miami School of Law. He obtained his Juris Doctor cum laude in 2003 and was admitted to practice in Florida and South Carolina the following year. His other bar admissions include the U.S. District Courts for the Southern and Middle Districts of Florida, the U.S. District Court for the District of South Carolina and the U.S. Court of Appeals for the 11th Circuit.

Fluent in Spanish and German, Mr. Drury helps a diverse range of clients with various issues ranging from catastrophic injuries to complex commercial and business disputes. His colleagues endorse him as a zealous attorney who goes the extra mile for his clients. He has helped clients recover multimillion-dollar settlements in securities litigation, personal injury and wrongful death cases. As a result, he has been made a life member of the Multi-Million Dollar Advocates Forum.

Mr. Drury has received several accolades for his quality legal representation over the years. He has been named a Florida Legal Elite in civil trial by the Florida Trend magazine and voted among the Top 40 Under 40 attorneys by The National Trial Lawyers. Moreover, the Cystic Fibrosis Foundation has listed him among the 40 Under 40 Outstanding Lawyers of South Florida.
Playing an active role in the legal community, Mr. Drury is a part of the Miami-Dade Trial Lawyers Association, the Law Society of England and Wales, The Florida Bar and the South Carolina Bar.
